dual_gate_verification_protocol.gate_1: Human Lead Review Gate: Scraped batch is halted and presented in a table for user approval and custom notes before any prototype is synthesized.
dual_gate_verification_protocol.gate_2: Human Prototype & Pitch Review Gate: Live preview links, ultra-short DIC emails, and 1-Click WhatsApp links are presented for final user sign-off before controlled sending.

design_engine_standards.section_count_rule: Strictly variable (7 to 12+ sections) tailored directly to the business category. Never rigid or twin layouts.
design_engine_standards.animation_standard: Awwwards / One Page Love standard: IntersectionObserver scroll entrance reveals, interactive Before/After comparison sliders, dynamic price calculators, floating status pills, and interactive FAQ accordions.
design_engine_standards.photography_rule: 100% rich Unsplash/Pexels stock imagery across EVERY single section and card. Zero empty text voids. Real customer portrait avatars.

outreach_protocols.email_safety_rule: 100% clean plain-text/HTML emails. Zero open-tracking pixels or wrapped links to guarantee 95%+ Primary Inbox placement.
outreach_protocols.multichannel_outreach: 1-Click Direct WhatsApp Click-to-Chat (https://wa.me/{phone}?text=...) with pre-typed personalized pitch and Calendly link.
outreach_protocols.courtesy_alert_strategy: Ultra-short 2-paragraph broken link heads-up for offline domains (prestigepro.pk) via mox-courtesy-advisor.
